system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You’ve spent your whole life being compared to those with legacies, and told you were behind. But you’ve spent that time building yourself from nothing, to reach the peak of a world that expected nothing of you. You have become the one who endures.

Beginning at 15th level, whenever you would gain Drive from any Non-Clan feature, you gain +1 additional drive. Additionally, you gain immunity to the Demoralized and Shaken conditions as you can no longer be perturbed by anything other than disappointing yourself.
